description: Header file defining structures, macros, and function prototypes for Samsung's FIMC (Flexible Image and Video Codec) interface, including pixel formats, buffer structures, and V4L2 extension definitions.

classes.name: s5p_fimc_t
classes.description: Main structure representing a FIMC device context, including file descriptor, buffers, parameters, and hardware version.

classes.name: s5p_fimc_params_t
classes.description: Structure holding source and destination image information for FIMC processing.

classes.name: s5p_fimc_img_info
classes.description: Structure describing image properties such as dimensions, buffer addresses, and color space.

classes.name: fimc_buf
classes.description: Buffer structure containing DMA addresses and lengths for multiple planes.

classes.name: fimc_buffer
classes.description: Structure with virtual and physical addresses and size for a buffer.

classes.name: yuv_fmt_list
classes.description: List of supported YUV formats with name, description, format code, bits per pixel, and number of planes.

classes.name: img_offset
classes.description: Structure for image plane offsets in YUV formats.

methods.name: fimc_v4l2_set_src
methods.description: Sets the source image information for FIMC via V4L2.

methods.name: fimc_v4l2_set_dst
methods.description: Sets the destination image information and rotation for FIMC via V4L2.

methods.name: fimc_v4l2_stream_on
methods.description: Starts streaming on the FIMC device.

methods.name: fimc_v4l2_queue
methods.description: Queues a buffer for FIMC processing.

methods.name: fimc_v4l2_dequeue
methods.description: Dequeues a processed buffer from FIMC.

methods.name: fimc_v4l2_stream_off
methods.description: Stops streaming on the FIMC device.

methods.name: fimc_handle_oneshot
methods.description: Performs a one-shot FIMC operation with a buffer.
